marketing_wrapper: None: the single screenshot is a raw full-bleed home screen with no caption, backdrop or frame (status bar cropped off). 100% real UI.

typography.display: SF Pro, regular/medium at large size for section headers ('Playlists', 'Podcasts') and the centred nav title 'Overcast'
typography.numerals: proportional SF inside caps labels ('35 MIN LEFT', '20 MIN LEFT'); episode numbers in titles
typography.weights: regular for podcast and episode titles (not bold), medium section headers; grey caps metadata
typography.case_and_tracking: tracked small all-caps for status and author lines (PAUSED, NEW, MARCO ARMENT, CASEY LISS); sentence case elsewhere

palette.accent_strategy: One brand orange for nav-bar actions (settings gear, search) and the selected playlist; each playlist also gets its own colour (orange, purple, blue, green) as a filled circle with a pale halo ring. Podcast artwork supplies the rest.
palette.source: palette.json 01 (#ffffff 57%, #f5f6f5 card and section-band fill, #fafaf9); orange and playlist hues read visually (system-like orange, purple, blue, green)

shape.radius_language: mixed: ~12-14pt continue-listening cards, ~8pt artwork, circles for playlist buttons, native rounded segmented control
shape.borders_shadows: continue-listening cards have a light grey fill plus a soft outer shadow/rim; hairline separators in the podcast list; the selected playlist has an orange ring

density: medium; 2x2 horizontally scrolling continue-listening cards, a row of 4 playlist circles, podcast rows ~110pt with 96pt artwork
layout: Home: centred title bar with gear and search; a horizontally scrolling 2-row shelf of in-progress episodes (artwork + caps status + title); 'Playlists' as large coloured circular buttons; 'Podcasts' list with Current/All segmented control, artwork-left rows with chevrons.
navigation: Native-style centred navigation bar with orange gear (settings) and search; native segmented control; disclosure chevrons on rows. No tab bar visible.
imagery_and_icons: Podcast cover art; SF Symbols-style glyphs (gear, magnifier, chevron) and white filled glyphs inside coloured circles for playlists (box, car, calendar, tray).
signature_visual_move: Playlists as big filled colour circles with a pale halo ring, set in an otherwise plain white, SF-native list app with orange actions.

direction_fit.primary: posture-only: native utility (platform fidelity plus one orange brand accent)
direction_fit.why: One raw screen shows a stock-iOS layout (SF, native segmented control, chevron rows) with one brand orange and per-playlist colour circles. That matches the text record's posture-only verdict; the identity lives in the audio features, which cannot be seen.

notes: Only one screenshot, so the player screen (where Overcast's signature controls live) is unseen. Low evidence for any visual field beyond the home screen.
